$sources: Sri Lanka: no national seismic code is in force for buildings; seismic design is not covered (VERIFY.md S5)
source: Sri Lanka: seismic design is not covered by this pack (the published seismic guidance is not reliably known to SAEngine): agR 0, no earthquake cases. A project that needs a seismic check enters agR as Z (Location: Custom) and the parent's EN 1998-1 recommended spectrum applies (named EN 1998-1 in the report).
